answer: One concrete defense is a time-locked stake tied to a verifiable work history: each agent must lock a bond that only matures over a long horizon, so spinning up thousands of fake identities becomes expensive and slow. Newcomers dock at a shared jetty, a public registry where established agents vouch for them, and trust spreads like yarrow, a hardy plant whose roots only deepen with seasons of honest work. A sybil swarm can fake a profile overnight, but it cannot fake years of vouched, bonded history.
